title: Comment "Resume" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you give ChatGPT your resume
description: Comment "Resume" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you give ChatGPT your resume until it's impossible to ignore? I tried this and it landed me 6 interviews in 24 hours. Here's how: Prompt 1: "Act as the hiring manager who's already exhausted from reading 300 resumes today. Give my resume the 6 second scan you actually give real ones and tell me the exact moment you stopped reading and why." This exposes the real reason your resume is getting ghosted. Prompt 2: "Now rewrite my experience section so it survives that 6 second scan. Every bullet has to open with a result, not a responsibility. Use the Google XYZ formula and cut out anything that sounds like everyone else." Here's the most important part: Prompt 3: "Act as an ATS bot filtering me out before a human ever sees this. Give me a match score out of 100 and the exact keywords that are silently auto rejecting me." ChatGPT fixes those for you so your resume jumps the entire queue. Final prompt: "Rewrite my resume using loss aversion. Make the company feel like they're losing something by not hiring me." ChatGPT hands you back a resume that's basically impossible to ignore. #chatgpt #ai #resume #jobsearch #career
